one_liner: Copper CRM has a documented REST Developer API using API keys (Professional+ plans, trial works) and partner-registered OAuth2; official MCP is in beta.
auth_notes: API key sent via X-PW-AccessToken, X-PW-Application and X-PW-UserEmail headers. OAuth2 authorization code is preferred for partner integrations, but registering an app requires emailing partners@copper.com, so API key is the practical self-serve primary. (The developer.copper.co/usecopper.com results describe different products.)
access_notes: No free plan. A 14-day free trial includes API access. Basic plan has no API; Professional and Business include it. API keys are generated in System settings > API Keys.
blocker_notes: API requires the Professional plan or higher, or a time-limited trial. OAuth2 app registration needs contacting Copper partners.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0. API Keys are suitable for individual users, while OAuth2.0 is the preferred approach for partner integrations.
No free plan. 14-day free trial, no credit card; signup is Google-only
Copper documents Developer API access on its trial, Professional, and Business plans.
